task.ques: Search for the word "nostalgia" in the Cambridge Dictionary and report the translation of this word into Chinese.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Cambridge Dictionary translates “nostalgia” into Traditional Chinese as “對往事的懷念，懷舊，念舊”.
Source: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-chinese-traditional/nostalgia
Evidence: final.png shows the Cambridge entry with “nostalgia” and its Chinese translation together.
